Yoga guru Ramdev seems to have got the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in a bind. Once a prominent voice against the erstwhile United Progressive Alliance (UPA) government over black money and corruption, Ramdev has trained his guns at Dhirendra Krishna Shastri, who has a growing following among the BJP brass, including Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
What's Ramdev's changing rhetoric? Apoorva Mandhani explains.
